thread:
Hana Kim: Hi! I accepted the orientation invite but my calendar shows it at 9:00 PM local. The welcome email said 9:00 AM PT. Also I don't see any Meet/Zoom link in the event itself. Is the event duplicated or am I missing something?
Luis - People Ops: Welcome Hana! Canonical time is 9:00 AM PT. Google Calendar should convert to your local timezone (that's 17:00 BST / 21:30 IST / 01:00 JST next day depending on DST). We always record and post the recording + a short recap clip in #new-hires.
Sam - Onboarding: Hey — sometimes people import the .ics and the client treats the time as "floating" which can create a duplicate at an unexpected local hour. Which email did you accept the invite with? If it wasn't your company address, conferencing links can be suppressed.
Hana Kim: I accepted with hana.k.personal@gmail.com (still waiting for my redwood account setup).
IT Ops: That explains it. When the organizer is onboarding@redwood.com, Meet auto-attaches for internal addresses only. I just re-shared the event from onboarding@redwood.com to hana.k.personal@gmail.com and forced the conferencing links to attach. Try refreshing your calendar in ~1 minute.
calendar-bot: Event updated: "Redwood Orientation (New Hires)" — Conferencing: Zoom + Google Meet attached. Recording enabled. Slides will be uploaded ~45 minutes before the session.
Luis - People Ops: Zoom backup: https://zoom.redwood.example/j/555666777 — we'll include both links in the event description and a short "how to join" section for folks using Outlook/AppleCal.
Nora (EM): Quick note for asynchronous folks: we upload the full recording to the onboarding Drive folder and also a 10-minute highlights clip in #new-hires within 24h. If you can't attend live, we can schedule a 15-min 1:1 recap with your manager.
Hana Kim: I can see the Zoom link now, thanks. One more Q: will slides be shared before the session? I like to skim.
Sam - Onboarding: Yes — slides go in the event and Drive folder ~45 min prior. Also added a small timezone table in the event description (PT / UTC / BST / IST / JST) and a troubleshooting FAQ for missing links, duplicate ICS, and Outlook issues.
Hana Kim: Great, thanks! Appreciate the clarity.
Luis - People Ops: If anyone else sees odd times or missing links, drop your city + the email you accepted with and well reissue or resend. Also ping me if you need the raw recording sooner for timezone reasons.
